description: Generates EIP-712 typed data for an EIP-2612 Permit. Authorizes the spender (default: protocol diamond) to pull `value` from signerAddress until `deadline`. Sign locally with your wallet (EIP-712); add the resulting signature to the returned transferAuthorization { strategy: 'EIP2612', data } and pass it in send_meta_transaction.transferAuthorizations. Returns: typedData to sign + transferAuthorization template.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which the permit is no longer valid.

exchangeTokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token contract address that supports the permit/authorization standard.

signerAddress.description: Ethereum address that will sign and send this transaction. Must match the wallet that will sign the returned transaction locally.

spender.description: Optional spender address. Defaults to the Boson Protocol diamond from SDK config.

tokenDomainName.description: EIP-712 domain name of the token contract (e.g. 'USD Coin'). Required for ERC-3009 / EIP-2612 domain separator.

tokenDomainVersion.description: EIP-712 domain version of the token contract (e.g. '2'). Required for ERC-3009 / EIP-2612 domain separator.

value.description: Amount in wei the spender is authorized to pull from the signer.

name: sign_receive_with_erc2612_permit
